primary_task: Analyze a set of provided pages for keyword overlap and cannibalization and return a cannibalization report with resolution strategies.

requirements.name: search-ranking-data
requirements.basis: No manifest sentence names a rank-tracking source; "web_search": "search the public web and read result snippets" may give approximate positions only.

requirements.name: google-search-console
requirements.basis: "accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, ...)"

notes: The document says it analyzes "provided pages" ("Analyze keywords in provided pages"), so the core analysis is done on text the user supplies, by the agent itself. The ranking field in the output template ("Ranking: #X") would need search-position data that the manifest does not provide; I read it as a template placeholder, not a hard requirement. Under a reading where real rankings must be filled in from Search Console, that credential is unavailable and the verdict would be BLOCKED. Search Console monitoring is part of an optional prevention framework.
